title: Tailwise Autoship Allowance on Pals Rewards Points Reversals
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** On a points reversal after a grooming pass is cancelled and refunded, a reversal Autoship allowance is kept back according to the charged shipments that the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions carry dated in the last six months, all subscriptions counted together.

| Charged Tailwise Autoship shipments dated in the last six months | Points kept back |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 25 |
| 3 to 5 | 10 |
| fewer than 3 | none |

**Edges (hypothetical).** 2 shipments: none. 3: 10. 5: 10. 6: 25.
